en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Idrees, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Ibn Abu Najran, from Safwan Al Jammal who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘The Azān is twice by twice, and the Iqamah is twice by twice’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ahmad ibn Idris has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from ibn abu Najran from Safwan al-Jammal who has said the following: “I once heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, say, ‘
Adhan is twice and twice and ‘Iqamah is twice and twice.’”
